rules.name: New cardmember bonus: 100,000 bonus points
rules.eligibility_notes: Spend $8,000 on purchases within 3 months of account opening. Page states the bonus may be unavailable to applicants who have ever held this card. Earn 100,000 bonus points after spending $8,000 on purchases in the first 3 months after account opening. Bonus posts 6 to 8 weeks after qualifying. This is the offer visible on the issuer page on 2026-10-28; the offer that applies to a recently approved account is the one shown at the time of application, so the owner should confirm the threshold and window on the approval terms. The page states a spend threshold ($8,000) and a window (3 months from account opening). Unlocks after $8,000 of spend (first 3 months after account opening); counting rule: purchases, as stated in terms

rules.name: DoorDash DashPass complimentary membership (12 months minimum) with up to $10 monthly off non-restaurant orders
rules.eligibility_notes: DoorDash orders while DashPass is active with the card; the $10 monthly discount applies to non-restaurant orders. Complimentary DashPass for at least 12 months when activated by 2027-12-31; includes $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees, plus up to $10 monthly off non-restaurant DoorDash orders. The page does not say whether unused monthly amounts roll over. Activate DashPass with the card by 2027-12-31.
